== Unique Maces ==
<noinclude>
In addition to the changes listed here, all melee weapons also gain <span class="nmod">Melee Attacks Deal Splash Damage</span>.

Ethereal weapons gain a x1.25 damage bonus instead of a x1.5 damage bonus.
</noinclude>

This is a regular item that can be used to open the [[Recipes#Portals|Secret Cow Level]]. It can also be [[Recipes#Imbue|imbued]], turned into a [[Recipes#Equipment_Creation_Recipes|magic item]] to [[Crafting|craft]] with, or used as a [[RWWeapons|runeword]] base like other regular items. It is considered a club, so can now get Druid pointmods/staffmods like other clubs.
